recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction required by the Published FHIR-7385 decision; FHIR-7366 can be audited separately as a same-change-family companion, and unresolved FHIR-50639 should not be represented as decided by this commit.
issue_request: FHIR-7385 was Published / Not Persuasive with Modification for a DSTU1 ballot comment asking whether omitted subject values on contained resources could always be inferred from the containing resource. The approved resolution was to disallow that functionality and explicitly say contained resources do not inherit values from their context because of the uncertainty this introduces.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 5814, now commit 6bb9d508d3ed2e099a0e5909d738553572502039, which changed source/references.html to say contained resources do not "inherit" context from their parent resource. That application left a pre-existing introduction sentence from aaf83231c2ec0df3cc0a3600f879c81cb614e9ca saying contained resources were the only exception to the no-inheritance/non-conduction statement.
additional_context: FHIR-7366 is the linked Published companion issue with the same approved no-inheritance resolution. FHIR-3691 and FHIR-5223 show the earlier context-conduction concern that FHIR-7385 strengthened, and unresolved FHIR-50639 later reports the exact contradiction between the introduction and contained-resource section. source/fhir.ini maps reference=references, confirming references.html is in current build scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/references.html:40 from saying contained resources are the only exception to saying contained resources follow the same no-inheritance rule, leaving the existing contained-resource section intact.
source_changes: source/references.html: replaced the stale 'only exception' sentence with 'Contained resources follow the same no-inheritance rule (see below).'
